description: Condition-resolved nspC and PP_2928 expression in KT2440 across 11 growth conditions, with genome-wide correlation null
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d2=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE322nnn/GSE322955/suppl/GSE322955_PP_log_tpm.csv.gz",
               compression="gzip",index_col=0)
cond=pd.Series([c.rsplit("_",1)[0] for c in d2.columns],index=d2.columns)
grp=d2.T.groupby(cond).mean().T
ctrl="PP_M9gluc"
lfc=grp.sub(grp[ctrl],axis=0)

genes={"PP_2929":"nspC","PP_2928":"CASDH","PP_0567":"speA","PP_2196":"speB","PP_0864":"speC",
       "PP_1867":"PP_1867","PP_1989":"asd"}
order=[c for c in grp.columns if c!=ctrl]
print("log2 fold change vs M9 glucose (mean of 2 replicates)")
print(f"{'condition':24s}"+"".join(f"{v:>9s}" for v in genes.values()))
for c in order:
    print(f"{c:24s}"+"".join(f"{lfc.loc[g,c]:9.2f}" for g in genes))

print("\nnspC absolute log TPM per condition (and genome percentile):")
for c in grp.columns:
    v=grp[c]
    print(f"   {c:24s} nspC {grp.loc['PP_2929',c]:6.2f} (pct {100*(v<v['PP_2929']).mean():5.1f})   PP_2928 {grp.loc['PP_2928',c]:6.2f} (pct {100*(v<v['PP_2928']).mean():5.1f})")

print("\nRank of nspC |log2FC| among all 5564 genes, per condition:")
for c in order:
    a=lfc[c].abs()
    print(f"   {c:24s} log2FC {lfc.loc['PP_2929',c]:+5.2f}  rank {int((a>a['PP_2929']).sum())+1:5d}/5564  pct {100*(a<a['PP_2929']).mean():5.1f}")

r,p=stats.pearsonr(d2.loc["PP_2929"],d2.loc["PP_2928"])
allr=d2.apply(lambda row: np.corrcoef(row,d2.loc["PP_2929"])[0,1] if row.std()>0 else np.nan,axis=1)
rk=int((allr.drop("PP_2929")>allr["PP_2928"]).sum())+1
print(f"\nnspC vs PP_2928: r={r:.4f} p={p:.2e}; PP_2928 rank {rk} of {allr.notna().sum()-1} non-self genes")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(d2.loc["PP_2929"],d2.loc["PP_2928"],s=45,color="#2a6f97",edgecolor="white",zorder=3)
m,b=np.polyfit(d2.loc["PP_2929"],d2.loc["PP_2928"],1)
xs=np.linspace(d2.loc["PP_2929"].min(),d2.loc["PP_2929"].max(),10); ax.plot(xs,m*xs+b,color="#c44536",lw=1.5)
ax.set_xlabel("nspC PP_2929 (log TPM)"); ax.set_ylabel("PP_2928 (log TPM)")
ax.set_title(f"A  nspC and PP_2928 co-expression\n22 samples, r = {r:.3f}, p = {p:.1e}",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(allr.drop("PP_2929").dropna(),bins=60,color="#9a9a9a")
ax.axvline(allr["PP_2928"],color="#c44536",lw=2)
ax.text(allr["PP_2928"]-0.05,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.75,f"PP_2928\nrank {rk}/5563",color="#c44536",fontsize=9,ha="right")
ax.set_xlabel("Pearson r with nspC"); ax.set_ylabel("genes")
ax.set_title("B  Genome-wide null for that correlation",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=axes[2]
lab=[c.replace("PP_","") for c in order]
y=np.arange(len(order))
ax.barh(y-0.2,[lfc.loc["PP_2929",c] for c in order],height=0.4,color="#2a6f97",label="nspC")
ax.barh(y+0.2,[lfc.loc["PP_2928",c] for c in order],height=0.4,color="#6aa84f",label="PP_2928")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change vs M9 glucose"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("C  Condition response of the operon",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
